tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Read published consulting services, pricing policy and contact URL. Use to assess engagement fit; does not book or send anything.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a published site markdown document by path, such as /index.md, /pricing.md or /auth.md.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search published site documentation using keywords. Returns source URLs and excerpts; no generated advice.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, search_docs · Private data: list_services, read_document · Public sink: list_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, search_docs · Private data: list_services, read_document · Public sink: list_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
